name: 2 Daily Brief
description: Market Agent · Search News · Daily Brief

parameters.query:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT p.stock_id, s.symbol, s.sector, p.trade_date, p.close,
         LAG(p.close) OVER (PARTITION BY p.stock_id ORDER BY p.trade_date) AS prev_close
  FROM daily_prices p JOIN stocks s ON s.id = p.stock_id
),
latest AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked
  WHERE trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_prices) AND prev_close IS NOT NULL
),
breadth AS (
  SELECT 'หุ้นในพอร์ต: ขึ้น ' || COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE close > prev_close)
      || ' ตัว / ลง ' || COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE close < prev_close)
      || ' ตัว จากทั้งหมด ' || COUNT(*) || ' ตัว' AS txt
  FROM latest
),
sectors AS (
  SELECT string_agg(sector || ': ' || avg_chg || '%', E'\n' ORDER BY avg_chg DESC) AS txt
  FROM (SELECT sector, ROUND(AVG((close / prev_close - 1) * 100), 2) AS avg_chg
        FROM latest GROUP BY sector) x
),
movers AS (
  SELECT stock_id, symbol, sector, ROUND((close / prev_close - 1) * 100, 2) AS change_pct
  FROM latest ORDER BY ABS(close / prev_close - 1) DESC LIMIT 5
),
movers_txt AS (
  SELECT string_agg(
    m.symbol || ' (' || m.sector || '): ' || m.change_pct || '%' || E'\n' ||
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT string_agg(line, E'\n') FROM (
         SELECT '  - [' || a.source || '] ' || a.title || ': ' || LEFT(COALESCE(a.summary, ''), 300) AS line
         FROM news_stocks ns JOIN news_articles a ON a.id = ns.article_id
         WHERE ns.stock_id = m.stock_id AND a.published_at >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
         ORDER BY a.published_at DESC LIMIT 3) x),
      '  - (ไม่มีข่าวในฐานข้อมูล)'),
    E'\n\n' ORDER BY ABS(m.change_pct) DESC) AS txt
  FROM movers m
)
SELECT to_char((SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_prices), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS report_date,
       b.txt || E'\n\n' ||
       'ภาพรวมรายกลุ่ม (เฉลี่ย % เปลี่ยนแปลง):' || E'\n' || s.txt || E'\n\n' ||
       'หุ้นที่ขยับแรงที่สุด:' || E'\n' || m.txt AS context
FROM breadth b, sectors s, movers_txt m
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM ai_reports
  WHERE report_type = 'daily_brief'
    AND report_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_prices)
);

INSERT INTO ai_reports (report_date, report_type, content, model)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Build Context').item.json.report_date }}'::date,
  'daily_brief',
  $report${{ $json.text }}$report$,
  'claude-haiku-5-5'
)
ON CONFLICT (report_date, report_type) DO UPDATE SET
  content = EXCLUDED.content, model = EXCLUDED.model, created_at = now()
RETURNING id, report_date;
